name: Otonoha Acoustics
description: Otonoha Acoustics is a quiet block theme for an architectural acoustic consultancy that measures rooms before finishes are specified. The first screen is a diagonal split: a pale upper half with the staggered headline, a dark low-key auditorium photograph below a rising seam with the second line in white, and a five-tick survey-day timeline. Four square room cards drift sideways across a pale band, a tall photograph stays put beside four measurements, the report feed runs off a white sheet, and a graphite band carries the single booking pill. Hanken Grotesk and Onest, silver-slate tones, quiet scroll effects.
